description: Stamina returns more slowly, and beast hands hinder precise work. Wyald’s favor feeds your strongest impulse; you remain his lesser fighter.

name.str: Bound protection: Beast of the Black Dogs

description: Your master and their marked servants leave you alone while you keep the pact. This protects you alone; it does not command demons or make them loyal to your companions.

name.str: Lesser senses: Beast of the Black Dogs

description: Stamina returns more slowly, and beast hands hinder precise work. Wyald’s favor feeds your strongest impulse; you remain his lesser fighter.

name.str: Body: Beast of the Black Dogs

description: Your permanent beastlike body grants +2 strength and -2 dexterity. Returning to human shape is impossible.

name.str: Borrowed impulse: Beast of the Black Dogs

description: Your limited fighting impulse requires recent service to your living master. The body and its weaknesses remain if the bond breaks, but this impulse falls silent.

name.str: Pawn: Beast of the Black Dogs

description: The limited servant’s body is complete. Neither more flesh nor the master’s death will turn it into an independent apostle. Your choices remain your own, but the pact has a lasting price.
